settings.name: max_days_between_recharges
settings.label: Max Days Between Recharges
settings.description: The setting forces a regeneration to occur at the selected value if it has been at least that many days since the last regeneration. If set to automatic, the calculation is made by the software to determine when the recharge is necessary. On average, this is every 2-7 days.

settings.name: chem_feed_volume
settings.label: Chemical Feed Volume
settings.description: This sets how much water must pass through the system before the auxiliary output turns on.

settings.name: chem_feed_seconds
settings.label: Chemical Feed Timer (Seconds)
settings.description: This set the duration for the auxiliary output.

settings.name: feature_97_percent
settings.label: 97% Feature
settings.description: If enabled, this will force an immediate regeneration to occur when the remaining capacity is at 3% or less.
